classification_rule.A: baseline fails, a larger factor completes six; at every commonly attempted level and bank ESS nondecreasing, survivor CV nonincreasing, total retained switches nondecreasing across factors; at least one strict ESS and balance improvement and a strict switching improvement at a multi-component generating contour
classification_rule.B: all three fail an ESS gate; each failing bank has survivor CV>=0.5 and at least four walkers with zero retained component switches while both components are observed in that bank
classification_rule.C: all other outcomes, including all budgets succeeding or a structural failure

comparison_tolerances.restart: dtype/shape/bytes exact arrays; canonical JSON exact metadata, candidate/ESS/decision records; no numerical tolerance

diagnostics.lineage: exact initial six-coordinate-block ancestry tokens, invalidated by slice updates and copied on accepted exchanges; immediate promotion hashes/donor IDs retained; not a proof of independent genealogical samples
diagnostics.mode_labels: argmax c_k NormalPDF(theta;mu_k,width_k), not posterior probabilities
diagnostics.survivor_balance: sample coefficient of variation across eight survivor fractions; nonzero walker count; largest survivor share
diagnostics.switches: successive retained dominant-component label changes per walker; also physical-sweep changes including burn-in

design.highest_successful_definition: largest factor that completes all six levels with every reliability gate passed
design.initialization: 16 independent prior states per walker per bank, initial_state SeedSequence(seed).spawn(2); pooled promotion to 8 walkers

interpretations.A: clear monotonic improvement in ESS / walker balance / mode switching and at least one larger budget completes all requested levels: current algorithm viable but baseline mixing too small
interpretations.B: all 1x/2x/4x show severe walker/modal persistence and fail reliability: more transitions insufficient; kernel robustness unresolved
interpretations.C: nonmonotonic or ambiguous: no production change justified

design.promotion: unchanged pooled with replacement; SeedSequence-v1 purpose/bank/iteration namespace
design.reconstruction: unchanged; no reconstruction streams generated or estimator evaluated in this mixing study
design.rng: same construction seed and initial states; same iteration/bank/purpose seeds; per-walker repeated threefry split; PCG64 label and MH arrays have identical common sweep prefixes. Factor f retains indices f*256+f-1, then every f sweeps. Round-robin sweep count extends unchanged. Different retained pools/contours cause matched random inputs to act on different states after level 1; promotion draw seeds remain matched but eligible-pool indexing can diverge.
design.stopping: unchanged and not invoked; termination remains UNVALIDATED

answers.baseline_mixing_insufficient: Baseline cross-mode mixing is insufficient at deep levels: no switching at levels 4–6. Baseline passed every ESS gate, so an ESS-budget deficiency is not established by this study.
answers.increasing_only_mixing_budget_solves_pro: Not demonstrated. All budgets pass ESS gates; 2x and 4x still have zero deep modal switching. This development model did not reproduce the historical Stage-8H ESS collapse.
answers.independently_held_out_end_to_end_valida: No, current CASE-C evidence does not justify another independently held-out end-to-end validation or a production budget change.
answers.monotonic_and_physically_interpretable: No robust monotonic improvement under the predeclared criteria. Early switching improves, but level-5 selection ESS and level-2 calibration survivor CV are nonmonotonic; deep persistence remains.
answers.smallest_robust_tested_budget: None established. 1x is the smallest tested budget passing all six ESS-gated levels, but no tested budget establishes cross-mode robustness.

final_stage9a_interpretation.diagnostic_distinction: Compression ESS can be high even when walkers remain trapped in separate modes. ESS reliability and cross-mode mixing diagnostics are different requirements. All walkers contributing candidate survivors does not prove cross-mode ergodicity.
final_stage9a_interpretation.interpretation: nonmonotonic / ambiguous; no production change justified

interpretation_limitations: Both Gaussian components have identical individual likelihood peak height 1/sqrt(2*pi). Similar conditional within-mode compression fractions can conceal modal allocation differences from the Bernoulli compression ESS gate.
Passing ESS and finishing six levels is not evidence that walkers mixed across disconnected modes; direct occupancy/switching diagnostics must be read separately.
This development model did not reproduce Stage-8H ESS collapse; it cannot establish that extra sweeps resolve that historical failure.
CASE C does not justify a production change or a new end-to-end termination validation on current evidence.

audit.exact_comparison_method: Canonical JSON, sorted keys, no numerical tolerance; NPZ key sets equal and each array dtype, shape and bytes equal.
audit.metadata_audit: All 56 4x and 46 restart JSON files inspected recursively: only result.json pid fields identify processes. Checkpoint metadata pins scientific configuration, environment, seed, streams, records and bank checksums, but contains no OS process identity. Logs contain level diagnostics and the initial import error, without PID/PPID or launch receipt. File mtimes are not process creation times; birth times are unavailable.
audit.rationale: Both results record PID 3. PID equality does not prove same process, and different namespaces or PID reuse cannot be established from these artifacts. The saved module command, later modification times and continuation log do not independently identify the OS process. The failed subprocess.run launch exited before sampling; it does not prove the corrected continuation used a distinct OS Python process.
